title: Refactor atom — base outputs.schema
description: Every refactor atom embeds these fields. Atoms extend by union with atom-specific fields. Advisory in v1 — profile-backed execution does not validate the provider emission against this shape.

status.description: Lifecycle state at atom emission time.

plan_path.description: Saved plan path; required when status=blocked or status=planned. Bare filename under $BLACKBOX_STATE_DIR/refactor/plans/.

files_touched.description: Files mutated by the run. Empty when status=blocked or status=planned.

plan_only.description: FIXMEs the plan emitted as plan-only markers (no associated edit).

warning.description: FIXMEs emitted alongside an applied edit, flagging operator follow-up.

deep_analysis_summary.description: Atom-specific subset of the deep_analysis report — captured_self_fields, unresolved_callbacks, resolved_callbacks, remaining_source_accessors, etc.

cargo_result.description: Final validation command result. Absent when status=blocked or status=planned.

block_reason.description: Required when status=blocked. Concrete diagnostic naming the precondition that failed (line numbers, plan_path, etc.).

done_note_id.description: ID of the bbox_note(kind="done") the atom emitted on completion.
